title: Reconcile aborted with HTTP 400 on the 3/29–3/30 pick files, whose game_pk is null
tier_reason: the aborted run wrote nothing wrong: dates re-checked before the abort kept their per-date results, and what did not run (re-checking 3/29–3/30 and, only if a correction was found, the streak recompute) is a safety net for rare late scoring changes; no state change is evidenced and the trigger is fixed

contract.text: bts reconcile re-checks every graded pick in its 8-day lookback against the MLB feed and recomputes the streak when a result changes.
contract.source: src/bts/cli.py reconcile docstring (ac7bc40); ARCHITECTURE.md at 0e23c0f ('bts reconcile: 8-day lookback for scoring changes … Cron at 2am ET')

mechanism.text: the pre-scheduler pick files for 3/29–3/30 carry game_pk null; check_hit always requested /game/{game_pk}/feed/live first, i.e. /game/None/feed/live (HTTP 400); retry_urlopen re-raises 4xx and reconcile_results had no per-date exception handling, so the error aborted the whole run

watchdog.trigger: the 2am reconcile run exits with an error or without its completion line in the cron log, or a graded date inside the lookback was not re-checked
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the next reconcile run completes over the full lookback and streak.json equals the forward replay of graded pick files

evidence.what: pre-scheduler picks (Mar 29–30) have game_pk null, 'which caused check_hit to request .../game/None/feed/live — an HTTP 400'; now falls through to the date-based search

evidence.locator: src/bts/picks.py reconcile_results and check_hit, src/bts/util.py retry_urlopen at ac7bc40
evidence.what: 400 is re-raised without retry and nothing in the lookback loop catches it, so one null-game_pk date ends the run
